symptom: `alter layout M.ProbeLayout { set (Tooltip: 'Go on') on actionButton1; }` on a layout built on another layout (`Layout: Atlas_Core.Atlas_Default`, widgets inside `placeholder Main { … }`) refused 'widget "actionButton1" not found' at check and exec, though describe printed the widget. alter page reached the same place on a page.
file: mdl/backend/pagemutator/mutator.go findBsonWidgetInLayout / layoutWidgetParents (also extractWidgetScopeFromBSON, findNearestDataSourceDoc). Test: mdl/backend/pagemutator/nested_layout_fill_2462_test.go
cause: A nested layout stores its widgets under Content.LayoutCall.Arguments[].Widgets (the shape a page has under FormCall.Arguments); the layout finder read Content.Widgets only, and the widget scope and data-source walk did not read a layout's Content at all.
insight: **Dump the stored shape before reasoning about where a widget lives** (`mxcli bson dump --type layout --format json`): a layout has two shapes, plain Content.Widgets and a nested layout's LayoutCall arguments. One helper that yields every widget parent (layoutWidgetParents) keeps the finder, the scope and the data-source walk from drifting apart again.
